```elixir title="Elixir"

result = LiterLlm.defaultclient_chat_async(client, "{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Hello\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"local-model\"}")
IO.inspect(result.choices)
IO.inspect(Enum.at(result.choices, 0).message.content)
```
